facts.value: Edisto Island lies mostly in Charleston County, with Edisto Beach (a separate town) in Colleton County; Edisto Beach (2010): 45.4% of year-round residents 65+, median age 63.3, 87.2% of 2,181 housing units rental or vacation; Hurricane Hugo spared the island i

facts.label: neighborhoods
facts.value: Edisto Beach (separate town), Wyndham Oceanridge, Frogmore, Fig Island, Oak Island, Cassina Point, Botany Bay

facts.label: place entities
facts.value: Edisto Beach State Park; Edisto Island Presbyterian Church; Edisto Island Baptist Church, Trinity Church and Botany Bay named in the Edisto Island article; no hospital on the island

facts.label: permit office
facts.value: Charleston County Building Inspection Services (843-202-6930) issues construction permits (page confirms unincorporated county service only by reference); the Town of Edisto Beach has its own building department (843-869-2505) for property inside that town. Ed
